summary: Iteration 220 — Guest PIN gate + Autonomous Ecosystem (Mike Mix observe/alerts) + Capo recognition. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed (gate levels master/guest/invalid, PUT guest requires admin, /mike/observe schema+400, /mike/alerts admin-only, alert creation+persistence, /mike/alerts/read). Frontend: public-gate guest flow renders guest-view with downtime-training + guest-barrier + guest-exit (no app-header, no admin unlock localStorage); master PIN 198505 opens full app; nexus-console + kill-switch-locked still render; MikeObserve returns anomaly+alert with observe-result & observe-alerted; MikeAlerts panel lists new alerts (2 unread, 4 total after test observe). Backend admin login returns 200, session works. Capo recognition text is present in source at App.js:307 mentioning Miki-Nexus & Mike Mix (UI open of account-menu failed only due to a Cyber-Trio shift-open modal intercepting after reload — not a functional bug).

A large blocking 'Shift Open · Cyber-Trio' modal ('Enter the console') appears immediately after admin login and obscures header/account-btn — should auto-dismiss or offer a clearer close button for keyboard/testing.

Ensure the Shift-Open Cyber-Trio wizard has an obvious close (or is skipped after first shown) so it does not obstruct the header/account menu on every reload.
